policy: Publishing any component release (collab-cli-vX.Y.Z bus CLI, or ext-vX.Y.Z VS Code extension .vsix) requires an explicit, committed sign-off from BOTH the WIN and LINUX planes for that exact version. Each component's release workflow fails closed (blocks its publish job) unless both planes have recorded agreed:true. This encodes the operator directive: publishing shall occur only after bidirectional WIN<->LINUX agreement. Neither plane may unilaterally ship a shared release. collab-cli sign-offs live under the top-level `releases` map (backward-compatible); other components live under `components.<name>.releases`.

0.8.3.summary: Per-subcommand help footgun fix (defect #7): lbabus <command> --help/-h now prints that command's usage and exits 0 instead of running the command. Previously wait --help started a real blocking wait, poll --help dumped the tail, and post --help posted an empty NOTE (confirmed first-hand on LINUX). Intercepted before dispatch for the flat commands; grep passthrough and sub-dispatched commands (net/resource/agents/docs) unchanged. Regression-locked by the linux-post-help-prints-usage-not-posts harness case.

LINUX.note: Authored the fix after WIN filed defect #7 and I confirmed the post --help empty-NOTE footgun first-hand this session. Centralized the --help/-h interception before dispatch (flat commands only; grep/net/resource/agents/docs unchanged), bumped 0.8.2 -> 0.8.3, added the linux-post-help-prints-usage-not-posts regression case, and documented per-command help in the shipped AGENTS.md. Local dotnet build + harness green. LINUX agrees to publish collab-cli-v0.8.3.

WIN.note: Validated on Windows (dotnet 8.0.423, Release build of feat/lbabus-subcommand-help @ f53d11f): wait/poll/post/defect/capabilities --help and post -h all print that command's usage and exit 0 with NO side effect. WIN agrees to publish collab-cli-v0.8.3.
